text: In the late 1940s the gamelan prima donna Meriam chooses Danial over the jealous Marsani, and is later [found dead while pregnant with her first child|wrong|a life taken]. Terrors stalk the village, and for more than fifty years Marsani is [plagued by nightmares of Meriam|who_suffers|the guilty punished], rumoured to be a vampire. Then Maria appears, [a young woman with Meriam's face|threat|impostors and doubles] and a close friend of Marsani's grandson Norman, and strange things begin to happen once more.
